lines.text: A round's report is now an item in the queue, with one button that marks it read.
Packets, merged pull requests, and digest lines carry the id of their round, and the pages group by round.
A stop packet's button reads "Answer and resume" and merges nothing, and the `merge` command refuses a pull request whose base isn't the default branch.
An approve now finds a design at the path its packet recorded, which fixes the approve the queue refused on 2026-11-11, and a new `restart` command rebuilds and restarts the app.
The brainstorming skill reads before it asks, and a design lists what done looks like.
The Go conventions skill is down to 1,394 words, with the rest moved to two reference files, and CI now caps it at 1,400.
The gate has a new lane that checks only the files you changed, it runs shellcheck, and the TypeScript, Go, and Svelte language servers are on.
